rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a soft bag or open container.

example.english: I usually take a cloth bag when I go out.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 tung1 soeng4 daai3 go3 bou3 doi6

rows.note: Use this when the bag is viewed as a packet, bundle, or quantity of goods rather than primarily as a reusable container.

example.english: I bought a bag of rice crackers.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 baau1 mai5 beng2
